# NVIDIA NemoClaw: Reference Stack for Sandboxed AI Agents in OpenShell
[Permalink: NVIDIA NemoClaw: Reference Stack for Sandboxed AI Agents in OpenShell](https://github.com/NVIDIA/NemoClaw#nvidia-nemoclaw-reference-stack-for-sandboxed-ai-agents-in-openshell)

NVIDIA NemoClaw is an open source reference stack for running supported AI agents more safely inside [NVIDIA OpenShell](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell) sandboxes. It provides guided onboarding, managed inference, network policy, managed integrations, snapshots, and lifecycle operations through the NemoClaw CLI and its agent-specific aliases.

For capabilities, architecture, security controls, and the full feature list, see the [NemoClaw documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/nemoclaw/latest/).

## Documentation
[Permalink: Documentation](https://github.com/NVIDIA/NemoClaw#documentation)

## Community
[Permalink: Community](https://github.com/NVIDIA/NemoClaw#community)

NemoClaw is an alpha project, so maintainers review issues, discussions, and pull requests on a best effort basis without guaranteed response timelines.

web.description:
![NemoClaw — NVIDIA Security Stack for AI Agents](https://cdn.nemoclawai.io/public/images/jensen-claw.png)

# NemoClaw
Powered by NVIDIA.

## NemoClaw FAQ
### What is NemoClaw?
NemoClaw is NVIDIA's open-source security stack for OpenClaw AI agents.

### What's the relationship between NemoClaw and OpenClaw?
NemoClaw is an NVIDIA-developed plugin that adds security controls to OpenClaw: sandboxed execution, network policies, privacy-preserving model routing, and audit logging.
